title: 「Unless + clause」表示「除非；如果不」

source.file: Sentence Structure 257 - 「Unless + clause」表示「除非；如果不」.pdf
omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF does not provide a complete English counterpart, the English text is a faithful editorial translation.
The source filename is numbered one lower than the system lesson because two distinct source PDFs are labelled 201; source number N therefore maps to system ID ssN+1.

formulas.formula: Unless + present tense, + will / may / can + base verb.
Imperative + unless + clause. / Unless + clause, + imperative.
Subject + would / could + base verb + unless + past tense.
Subject + would / could have + past participle + unless + past perfect.

exampleZh: 除非我們現在採取行動，否則問題將會惡化。

meaning.zh: Unless 是一個連接詞，用來提出必要條件或唯一例外，通常相當於 if ... not。unless 後面必須接一個通常包含主語和有時態動詞的子句。

rules.zh: 談論普通未來條件時，unless 子句通常使用現在式，不使用 will；主要子句則可以使用 will。
rules.en: For an ordinary future condition, normally use the present tense in the unless-clause, not will. The main clause may use will.
examples: Correct: Unless it rains tomorrow, we will play outside.
Incorrect: Unless it will rain tomorrow, we will play outside.

rules.zh: Unless 本身已包含「如果不」的意思，應避免不必要的雙重否定。Unless you do not hurry 的意思與 Unless you hurry 完全不同。
rules.en: Unless already contains the meaning if ... not, so avoid unnecessary double negatives. Unless you do not hurry has a different meaning from Unless you hurry.

rules.zh: unless 子句必須表達真正的條件或例外：只有某條件發生，主要結果才會改變。不是每個含 if ... not 的句子都能自然改成 unless。
rules.en: The unless-clause must express a real condition or exception: the main result changes only if the condition occurs. Not every sentence containing if ... not can naturally become an unless sentence.

rules.zh: Unless 表示條件；until 表示某情況持續至某個時間點。兩者可能描述相似情況，但文法功能和重點不同。
rules.en: Unless expresses a condition, whereas until shows that a situation continues up to a point in time. Their grammatical functions and emphasis are different.

rules.zh: 不要以 unless 和 or 重複表達同一條件。Unless 已連接條件和結果，不需要再加 or。
rules.en: Do not use both unless and or for the same condition. Unless already connects the condition and result.
examples: Unless you leave now, you will miss the train.
Leave now, or you will miss the train.

rules.zh: unless 子句和主要子句可以有不同主語，只要兩者的邏輯關係清楚。
rules.en: The unless-clause and the main clause may have different subjects, provided that the logical relationship is clear.
examples: Unless the teacher gives us more time, we cannot finish the task.

benefits.zh: Unless 能清楚指出必須發生甚麼事情，才能避免某個結果。
benefits.en: It makes the necessary condition clear by showing what must happen to prevent a particular result.

benefits.zh: 它可以取代較長的 if ... not 否定條件，使意思更直接並避免額外使用 not。
benefits.en: It can replace a longer negative condition, expressing the same condition more directly than repeated if ... not clauses.

benefits.zh: 它特別適合警告和建議，能說明如果不採取行動可能出現的後果。
benefits.en: It is useful for warnings and advice because it explains the possible result of failing to take action.

benefits.zh: 它可以說明某件事在甚麼條件下才獲准、可行、必須進行或不會發生，適合規則和要求。
benefits.en: It helps you state rules and requirements by explaining when something is allowed, required or possible.

benefits.zh: 條件可放在主要訊息之前或之後，提供兩種自然語序，避免所有句子使用相同開頭。
benefits.en: It gives you two natural sentence orders by allowing the condition before or after the main message.

benefits.zh: 它可自然用於日常對話、指示、校規、報告、通告、合約等正式和非正式情況。
benefits.en: It works in both everyday and formal situations, including conversations, instructions, school rules, reports, notices and agreements.

en: Rewrite each sentence using an unless-clause.
The unless-clause may appear before or after the main clause. Preserve the original meaning, tense, modality and logical condition. The first word is provided.
zh: 使用 unless 子句改寫以下句子。
Unless 子句可以放在主要子句之前或之後。保留原句的意思、時態、情態和邏輯條件。每題已提供答案的第一個字。
